question: Relate the eight new inference records to their compute copies: inference/assemblyai, inference/deepgram, inference/elevenlabs, inference/speechmatics, inference/cartesia, inference/voyage-ai, inference/stability-ai and inference/leonardo-ai describe the same offers as compute/assemblyai, compute/deepgram, compute/elevenlabs, compute/speechmatics, compute/cartesia, compute/voyage-ai, compute/stability-ai and compute/leonardo-ai. Should each pair get a same_offer_as relation, or should the compute copy be retired as a duplicate?
why: the compute copies describe a machine shape that these services do not have (their per_object_cap and retention say 'the unit is a machine'); the inference records carry the same offer with the unit, models, identity and API stated. Two records of one offer split a reader's view.
